candidates.name: gan-style-harness
candidates.author: affaan-m
candidates.description: GAN-inspired Generator-Evaluator agent harness for building high-quality applications autonomously. Based on Anthropic's March 2026 harness design paper. Use when a feature should be built autonomously through generator and evaluator iteration until it clears a quality bar.

candidates.name: scholar-evaluation
candidates.author: affaan-m
candidates.description: Structured scholarly-work evaluation for papers, proposals, literature reviews, methods sections, evidence quality, citation support, and research-writing feedback. Use when evaluating academic or scientific work — papers, proposals, methods sections, or evidence quality — against a repeatable rubric.

candidates.name: arxiv

candidates.name: graphify
candidates.author: Graphify-Labs
candidates.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

candidates.name: hps-academic-paper

candidates.description: A review deck on compositional generalization in large language models — the field map, the gap, the evidence, and open questions. Built as a decision-grade academic research deck for PI, lab group, reviewers.

candidates.name: html-ppt-zhangzara-pin-and-paper
candidates.author: nexu-io
candidates.description: A field-biology capstone on urban pollinator decline — the survey design, the data, the contribution, and the caveats. Built as a decision-grade coursework defense deck for faculty reviewers.

candidates.name: magazine-poster
candidates.author: nexu-io
candidates.description:
An editorial-style poster — newsprint paper, dateline, oversized serif
headline with a struck-through word and italic accent, a 2-column body
block, and 6 numbered sections with annotated pull-quote captions.
Reads like a Sunday-paper full-page essay or a thoughtful launch poster.
Use when the brief asks for "magazine poster", "editorial poster",
"newsprint", "essay layout", or "manifesto".

candidates.name: wireframe-sketch
candidates.author: nexu-io
candidates.description:
A hand-drawn wireframe exploration — graph-paper background, marker /
pencil tone, multiple tab labels for variants, sticky-note annotations,
scribbled chart placeholders, hatched fills. Reads like a designer's
whiteboard before any pixels are committed. Use when the brief asks for
"wireframe", "sketch wireframe", "hand-drawn", "lo-fi", "whiteboard",
"草稿", or "手绘原型".
